scope: Use complete eligible consumer contracts from the existing bounded paid NBA response, including dates prepared before a later date triggers the shared request.
problem: Fallback previously required a missing game/market scope and filtered out every quote in covered scopes. A distinct complete consumer-book pair was discarded even when already fetched. Sequential date processing could finish today before a future-date gap acquired the shared league response.
repair: The same service prepares bounded dates sequentially, acquires at most the existing one lazy league request only when a primary consumer-market gap exists, then finalizes each prepared date sequentially through its existing sole writer. Complete BDL physical-book contracts keep exact priority; complete eligible paid-book gaps fill next; native Owls consumer gaps fill afterward.
providerPolicy: No request, polling, book roster, market roster, date-window, lease or parallelism expansion. No provider calls or DB writes were performed during implementation or tests.
contracts: Pair identity binds exact fixture, book family, market, native provider event, native timestamp and actual response receipt.

Actual paid response completion is stored in availableAt and never renewed on later date reuse. Native quotes after response availability, future receipt, missing clocks, post-start additions, different fixture times and nonexecution books fail closed.
A singleton or incomplete primary fragment cannot splice into a complete backup pair. Complete same-book BDL pairs remain unchanged even if backup prices appear better.
No Circa or Pinnacle quote is relabeled as a consumer offer. Hard Rock aliases identify one physical book.
One-date operator wrapper preserves the same prepare/finalize service. No-game return values and provider/error preservation use the existing paths.

Runtime R36 reads only bounded exact R35 then R34 unlocked knowledge for missing games; current state wins, R35 wins over R34, and the same event/state validation remains fatal. Existing R35/R37/R26 locked DTO fields remain authoritative without reconstruction or mutation.

regressionEvidence.reachableSyntheticProof: Three complete primary game/markets leave zero missing game/market scopes, yet a unique valid paid FanDuel ML pair must add two rows. Existing code discarded both rows; repaired physical-book reconciliation adds both and retains all original primary rows.
regressionEvidence.coordinatorProof: Production route uses the tested coordinator. Ordered events are prepare(today), prepare(future), one fetch, finalize(today), finalize(future). The earlier complete date consumes the unique book pair from the later-triggered response. Fully covered dates make zero backup calls.
regressionEvidence.negativeCases: Singleton, different native time, different event, different actual receipt, native time after receipt but before evaluation, future/missing receipt, different fixture/participants, professional/context-only book, post-start addition and Hard Rock duplicate family.
regressionEvidence.compatibility: Literal R35/R37/R26 locked DTO round-trip remains exact; existing predecessor-state and writer/reader immutability suites remain required.
regressionEvidence.realServiceProof: The actual coordinator, real prepareNbaLines and real finalize dry-run run with all I/O replaced in memory. Two original Owls and four BDL mock reads prepare both dates before one paid mock response; today retains six primary rows and adds the new two-sided paid-book pair. The unoffered future date retains its three missing-scope errors. The actual one-date wrapper no-game path fetches nothing and original DB-load errors propagate unchanged.
regressionEvidence.knowledgeContinuity: Canonical native source-anchor state available only under R34 on a future slate continues into R36 with original knowledgeAt and anchors. Current R36 wins; R35 wins over R34; corrupt R35 is fatal; arbitrary old releases remain excluded.

boardImpact.actualPublishedBeforeAfter: Not measured: the authenticated production response's 630 per-event quotes were not supplied to this audit, so no specific skipped book, new forecast, probability, promotion or demotion is claimed from that aggregate.
boardImpact.productionReceiptReportedByOwner: Normal 16:42 refresh authenticated successfully: 18 events, 630 quotes, 3 credits used, 18361 remaining. These are aggregate feed diagnostics, not consumed-pair proof.
boardImpact.prospectiveVerification: The existing refresh now reports per-date theOddsApiPairsAdded, theOddsApiBooksAdded and owlsPairsAdded. Verify those alongside normal live release, coverage, coherent scores/probabilities/grades and exact locked-record preservation after publication.
boardImpact.gradeRules: No grade thresholds, EV protection, probability law, sharp confirmation rule, stake rule or target-book priority was loosened. Different newly available contracts can legitimately change the selected execution offer or evaluated grade; this repair does not promise a Best Angle count.

publication: Root owns registry/safety documentation, current-main integration, full model gate, intentional commit, protected PR and live verification. No commit or deployment was performed by this implementation agent.
